title: NinjaOne (Public API v2, API Services client with the Monitoring scope only)
readScopes: A NinjaOne API Services (machine-to-machine) client app (Configuration > Apps > API > Client App IDs > Add) with the single scope Monitoring ("grants read-only access to monitoring data and organization structure") and the Client Credentials grant type. The collector asks /ws/oauth/token for scope=monitoring and reads GET /v2/devices and GET /v2/queries/computer-systems, /volumes (include=bl), /operating-systems and /device-health. The instance URL (https://app, us2, eu, ca or oc .ninjarmm.com) is NINJAONE_URL; the client id and secret are NINJAONE_CLIENT_ID and NINJAONE_CLIENT_SECRET.

checks.title: Each Windows workstation's C: volume is fully BitLocker-encrypted and protected
checks.scope: Every Windows device, from the volumes report with include=bl: C: bitLockerStatus conversionStatus FULLY_ENCRYPTED and protectionStatus PROTECTED passes; other states fail; UNKNOWN, no C: volume, Macs and Linux hosts are skipped.

checks.title: Each device runs an OS at or above the given minimum version
checks.scope: Every device whose platform has a --ninjaone-min-os floor, from the operating-systems report (Windows as 10.0.<buildNumber>, others from the version in the OS name); without the option the check is skipped once.

checks.title: Each device has no failed OS patch and no more pending OS patches than allowed
checks.scope: Every device, from the device-health report: failedOSPatchesCount 0 and pendingOSPatchesCount at most --ninjaone-max-pending-patches (default 0). A device with no health row is skipped.

checks.title: Each device has contacted NinjaOne within the last 14 days
checks.scope: Every device, from lastContact in List devices; the window is --ninjaone-contact-days.

checks.title: Each device is approved for management in NinjaOne
checks.scope: Every device, from approvalStatus: APPROVED passes, PENDING or STAGED fails, DECOMMISSIONED is skipped.
